set.body: Implement a deterministic headless work scheduler, scope.latest, synchronous actions and asynchronous commands with independent concurrency/acceptance, after-commit launch, rollback, cancellation/disposal and bounded status. Add independent policy/lifetime oracle, focused snapshot-save tests and fresh-context source review. Run JVM/Native plus authoring/probes and checkpoint only owned files. Real threaded adapter, progress channels, deadlines and graphics remain separate.
set.title: C1.6a/C1.7 controlled tasks and commands
